caption: Maxima of regions showing significant BOLD signal changes in comparison of Go stimuli vs. baseline condition from patients with PD and controls.
footer: sup=superior; inf=inferior; ant=anterior; post=posterior; mid=middle; med=medial; R=right; L=left; BA=Brodmann area. Only regions that survived after correction for multiple comparisons (pCorrected<0.05) have been considered. See text for further details.
